messages.subject: Re: rattle: error loading R dataset
messages.body_plain:
Thanks for the dataset George, and for reporting the issue.

You mention that you do the following:

> dataset <- read.csv('../data/George.Dontas/imagedata.csv', header=FALSE)
> names(dataset) <- c(paste('pixel.',rep(1:400),sep=''),'digit')

Then you load it as an R Dataset into Rattle.

Looks like Rattle is confused by the name being "dataset". Loading
directly as a CSV file (using the "Spreadsheet" option) works just
fine.

Also, it works just fine if you use "ds" instead of "dataset" and load
it into Rattle as an R Dataset.

It is a Rattle bug and will be fixed in the next release.

Regards,
Graham

Thanks for the confirmation Jim.

Knowing others are also having this problem is very useful.

I'm thinking it might be a NAMESPACE issue (new in R 2.14.0) but only
affecting Mac OS/X.

A work around for now might be:

> library(rattle)
> set.cursor <- rattle:::set.cursor
> rattle()

Regards,
Graham
